prompt: a new song: deep rich bass, very real, cello, flute, violin, piano, music you feel held by; the existing songs are too tinny, small and lo-fi

requests.ask: i want a new song. deep rich base. very real. chello, flute, violine, poiano. i want to feel held by the music. our songs are too tinny, too small, too lo-fi. just a few sections so we can nail down a feel

changes.why: every part is raw (plain note().s()) so no synth attack or filter envelope lands on a bowed string or a struck piano: the layers are what made the older songs read as electronic
cps .27 (65 bpm) in D:dorian, warm minor with the raised sixth, so IV and VII come out major (Dm G C F)
room ir hall, size 3.2, damping 4500: one 3.2 s hall over every part, the thing that makes a small song big
sine sub on the chord root at d1-f1, level .5, space .3 - the deep the older songs had none of, felt rather than heard (measures lowRatio 1.00)
arco gm_contrabass on the root an octave over the sub, level .75, the attack a sine cannot give
gm_cello a written tenor line, level .85, position -.15 - the voice of the low end, never just roots
the real sampled piano pack, left hand then the chord held under a 1.7 clip (pedal), position -.25
gm_violin takes the tune: root, step up, a held fourth, a leap to the octave, home; velocity shapes the phrase
gm_flute answers only in the bars the violin leaves open, space .7
gm_string_ensemble_1 opens underneath at width .8, space .85 - the part that does the holding, climax only

requests.ask: i dont see parts listed. i dont see materials. hold cracks, and there is no deep bass rumble

changes.why: raw parts have no materials in the mixer (matsRender shows only 'pattern expr') and orbitKey gives every raw part a private orbit: seven raw parts built seven convolvers of the 3.2 s hall and the climax traced 59% busy with a dropout. Cello, violin and flute are melody layers now, the contrabass and the string bed are pads: three orbits instead of seven, 33% busy, no dropouts, and every part has knobs, a sound pick and a notes box

the sub was a 37 Hz sine with nothing above it, so only a subwoofer could hear it. Now a sawtooth at d1 lowpassed to 160 Hz: the fundamental plus 73, 110 and 147 Hz, which is what a speaker rumbles with. Measures centroid 68 Hz and -5.4 dB under the mix; the mix centroid fell 675>449 Hz
the sub stays a raw part because the bass layer's hap is one grid step (0.24 s here) so its note could not hold the bar
violin level 1.4>1.9 and flute 1.1>.9 - the tune measured 2 dB under its own counter-line

requests.ask: add a deep organ bass rumble / how do we get rumble without clipping?

changes.why: the rumble is now a stack of two sounds in one raw part: the sawtooth at d1 under a 160 Hz lowpass (measured alone centroid 68 Hz, 95% under 300) plus a vcsl pipe organ pedal on the same root under a 300 Hz lowpass for body. The organ alone was tried as a replacement and measured centroid 254 Hz with 34% under 300 and dropped the mix lowRatio .47>.29: a pedal pipe is low-mid colour, not bottom. Stacked, mix lowRatio .47>.55 and centroid 495>368 Hz
one raw part holding both, not two: every raw part gets a private orbit and an orbit is a convolver of the 3.2 s hall

compressor threshold -18 ratio 3 attack .02 release .3 on the pair, and level 1.1>.62 - at 1.1 the part measured -1.3 dB under the mix and the mix peaked .952 against the output wall; at .62 it is -2.9 dB, peak .812, clip 0.000, and the trace stays at 34% busy with no dropouts
clip 1.04 and release .7 on the organ because the vcsl pedal files are 12.7 s and an unclipped hit plays to the end, stacking four pedal notes on every bar

requests.ask: in the ui i only see melody in section 1 but i hear raw, pad, melody, raw2 - is the ui filtering or breaking? / the song sounds nice but i cannot feel any bass - is that a limitation of strudel?

changes.why: every layer value is an object literal now ({ ...sub(SUB) } rather than sub(SUB), { ...bass } rather than bass): locate() in lib/resolve.mjs skips any section property whose value is not an ObjectExpression, so a call or a bare identifier is invisible to the Mix card. Only melody was written as a literal, which is why only melody was listed. Audio is unchanged; the check tables before and after are identical
space .35>0 - the raw space cell is piece(0, .5, .95), not a no-op under .5, so the 37-110 Hz drone was sitting in a 35% send to the 3.2 s hall and smearing into a wash with no edge
articulation .1>.6 - at .1 the pad attack is .51 s, so every contrabass note faded in over half a second and nothing in the bottom of the song marked a beat; its tail measured .63>.36

a new pizzicato contrabass on the downbeat, dry and short: what the body reads as bass is a fast envelope at 50-100 Hz, and every other low part sustains (crest 3.5-4). The bass layer's one-grid-step hap is useless for a drone and exactly a pizzicato

level 1.3>2, weight .65, articulation .8>.6 and a compressor (threshold -20, ratio 4): it first measured crest 15.2 at -23.9 dB under the mix, a spike with no body. Now -12.6 dB, crest 10.9, depth .47, the closest part in the mix

requests.ask: this is not a trick: note('c2').s('sine').gain(1).slow(4)

changes.why: the sub moves up an octave, d1>d2, and goes back to a plain sine. The user's clean 65 Hz sine at unity gain settled it: the octave mattered, not the waveform. A sine at d1 (36.7 Hz) is inaudible on a laptop, a phone or most headphones because the driver cannot move air that low, and neither level nor the shape(.45) saturation I tried rescued it. At d2/c2 (65-98 Hz) a bare sine is plainly bassy. Measured: the part's centroid 107>100 Hz with lowRatio .79>.90, and the mix lowRatio .52>.65 with centroid 377>302 Hz, the best low end of the five versions
the pipe organ pedal stays an octave under the sine (.sub(note(12))) for body, and the shape(.45) is gone: a saturated wave was solving a problem the octave had already caused
